notes: Safety hardening from an expert code audit: destructive device actions (reload, erase, install activate/commit, shut) now ALWAYS ask for confirmation — one earlier "yes" can no longer silently green-light a reload later in the same task.

Wingman now answers "how is this WLC connected?", "why is WPA3 better?", "what is a gateway?" correctly instead of describing your own PC; and it won't claim an upgrade is "committed" unless it actually read that from the device.
MagicPing graph now has labeled axes (latency in ms on the left, time along the bottom). Plus the boot-watcher's ping phase and a post-upgrade cleanup offer.
